entities.summary: James Alfred Ennis III is an American professional basketball player for Piratas de La Guaira of the Superliga Profesional de Baloncesto (SPB). He played two years of college basketball for the Long Beach State 49ers, where he won the Big West Player of the Year in 2013. After being selected by the Atlanta Hawks in the second round of the 2013 NBA draft, Ennis moved to Australia and helped the Perth Wildcats win the 2014 NBL championship.
